document-generator.description: Create DOCX, PPTX, PDF, and XLSX documents, transform XLSX/CSV/TSV spreadsheets, extract text from PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/ODT workspace documents, edit PDF text, convert workspace documents to agent-ready Markdown, and manage Document Generator references/view state. Read existing Markdown and plain-text files with app.storage.storage_read_text.

argument_schema.description: Document Generator command arguments. With no action, generates a document from spec.

spec.description: Document generation specification for generate_document or validate_spec.

workspace_relative_path.description: Input file under storage/uploaded/ or storage/generated/. Required for extract_text, patch_pdf_text, modify_uploaded_document, spreadsheet.transform inputs, and convert_to_markdown; Markdown conversion accepts files up to 10 MiB.

source_files.description: Spreadsheet source files for spreadsheet.transform. Entries may be workspace paths or {alias,path} objects.

base_file.description: Optional existing workbook to copy when target_file does not exist.

target_file.description: Generated Storage target path for spreadsheet.transform.

mode.description: Spreadsheet transform write policy. overwrite requires confirm=true when target_file exists.

confirm.description: Required with mode=overwrite for an existing target_file.

operations.description: Spreadsheet transform operations such as lookup_and_copy, write_cells, or find_values.

patches.description: PDF text patches for patch_pdf_text. Each item accepts match_text, replacement_text, occurrence, redact_original, case_sensitive, and optional page_number.

match_text.description: Source text to replace for modify_uploaded_document or a single PDF patch.

confirmed_match_text.description: Confirmed source text after modify_uploaded_document returns multiple candidates.

occurrence.description: 1-based match occurrence to replace, or all for patch_pdf_text patches.

redact_original.description: When true, redact matched PDF text before inserting the replacement.

output_filename.description: Plain Markdown output filename for convert_to_markdown, for example report.md.

title.description: Optional display title for a converted Markdown artifact.

metadata.description: Optional caller metadata stored under document.metadata.request_metadata for Markdown conversion.

return_markdown.description: When true, include bounded Markdown text in the response. The Markdown file is always written.

max_return_chars.description: Maximum Markdown characters returned inline when return_markdown is true.

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted text characters returned by extract_text.

entity_id.description: Document reference id for reference resolve/summarize actions.
